extension.summary: Watch F1 live streams and full race replays in Kodi
extension.description: Two sources in one addon: LIVE F1/motorsport streams from daddylive (race, qualifying, practice as they happen), and FULL RACE REPLAYAYS from fullraces.com (F1, F2, F3, NASCAR, IndyCar, Formula E, WRC, WSBK). No more popup hell — just clean Kodi playback.
extension.disclaimer: This addon scrapes publicly available streaming links. The author does not host or stream any content. For educational use only.
extension.s: v2.8.14 - DIAG: resolve failures now toast + log the exact failing STEP (STEP1 watch.php / STEP1b no iframe / STEP2 stream page / STEP2b no iframe / STEP3 all embed hosts + host list / STEP3b no SRC / STEP4 edge manifest). Resolve retries once (2s) before failing. Wider embed fallbacks: +dembed.st (observed live 2026-11-02), +bembed.sbs. fetch_page timeout 20s->25s. v2.8.13 - SPLIT: replays are now PC-only. Every fullraces route is gated behind PC_REPLAYS (bin/curl-impersonate.exe present — Windows only); on any other platform the replays menu is hidden and deep-links get a clean "needs the PC build" notice instead of a traceback. Replays lane itself unchanged (2.8.12 parser). Live lanes identical on all platforms. v2.8.11 - FIX: old Sky F1 English (main lane) works again. Edge is now token-gated: player page fetches /api/playlist-token (needs full browser CORS headers — Origin+Referer of the embed, Sec-Fetch set) and the playlist URL gets the token appended. Resolve fetches the token; unwrap-proxy polls tokened and re-tokens at ~110s so long races never stall. v2.8.10 - Android-safe backup servers: HTTP now goes urllib-first with unverified SSL (Kodi Android's Python has no usable CA store — cert failures blanked every fetch; curl-impersonate.exe kept as Windows fallback only). v2.8.9 - New: 32-second delayed watch — the relay now pre-downloads the next ~32s of stream and publishes the playlist that far behind live, so upstream freezing bursts are ridden out invisibly (no stalls, no buffering spinner). Also: relay cache eviction so long races can't fill RAM.
extension.news: v2.8.18 - REPLAYS EVERYWHERE: backend gate now self-dispatches — Windows+exe keeps the live fullraces.com scrape, everything else falls back to the GitHub replay-catalog (ok.ru direct MP4, the .ru streams) which has shipped in the Android flavor since 2.8.14 but was never menu-wired until now. Android replays restored. v2.8.15 - DIAG2: backup-server "unreachable" toasts now append the real reason (DNS/timeout/SSL from f1_servers.http_error()). Android track gets the same code. v2.8.8 - Fix: numbered backup servers listed as folders (empty on click) — now playable items. v2.8.7 - Backup servers live: numbered Sky F1 lineup — 1./2./3. Sky F1 UK (nexa/vertex/kora), 4./5. Sky F1 DE, 6. F1 ES — auto-failover on resolve failure, signatures re-resolved pre-emptively (~30min window). Top banner: current/next F1 event + Adelaide start time, e.g. "Singapore Grand Prix · starts 10:30pm". v2.8.3 - Self-healing upstream: if the edge/embed host dies mid-play ("It ran and died", stalls + demuxer EOF 2026-10-10), the proxy re-runs the resolve chain in the background and hot-appends fresh segments — play continues seamlessly, no sequence break (upstream rotated embeds twice that night: dembed.top, daddyliveplayer.st, bembed.sbs). v2.8.2 - Embed-host rotation fix: dembed.top NXDOMAIN broke resolution ("unplayable item" 2026-10-10). Resolver now walks page host + daddyliveplayer.st fallback (embed path+query kept). Referer = the embed host that worked. v2.8.1 - Live-window proxy rewrite: dedicated refresher thread, appendix ledger, prefetch, ThreadingHTTPServer (fixed ~15s stalls). Segment 403 fix: Referer must be assetrage.net v2.7.1 - Fixed stream resolver: assetrage.net _econfig now 3-layer (b64 chunks, char-strip, slot reorder). English Sky F1 UK + DAZN F1 ES verified live. v2.7.0 - Lineup rebuilt: dlive.sx (current DaddyLive) now primary. Only 2 channels kept — Sky Sports F1 UK (English) + DAZN F1 ES (Spanish). Old daddylive channels.json + SportHD backups removed (dead upstream). v2.3.0 - Updated for daddylive.mov. v2.0.0 - Added fullraces.com race replays. v1.0.0 - Initial release.
